newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CVNE closes share sale subscription early.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CVNE closes share sale subscription early.

text.p: Spain's wine producer Compania Vinicola del Norte de Espana (CVNE), which markets the Cune rioja brand, closed the retail share subscription period for an initial public offering of 22.46 percent on Monday.
The share offer opened on Monday morning and closed at 5 p.m. (1500 GMT), the Spanish National Stock Market Commission (CNMV) said in a statement.
The public offer was initially scheduled to run until July 16.
A new calendar for the share offer is as follows:
July 8 - price fixed for the retail offer
July 9-11 - bids for retail shares accepted; subscription period for institutional tranche
July 14 - final volume assigned to each tranche
